name: NCDE Poseidon
description: NCDE desktop environment — build, ISO, and development workspace

session-start.template: Read AGENTS.md, the CLAUDE.md instructions, SESSION_HANDOFF.md, and MEMORY.md. Then output the session start checklist from AGENTS.md with every field filled in based on what you read.

check-tree.template: Show the current state of ~/ncde-x11/etc/ncde/ and key config files.

build-lelan.template: Build lelan-host from ~/ncde-staging/compass7/lelan/ and report compile output.

sync-docs.template: Read SESSION_HANDOFF.md and MEMORY.md to understand current state. Then: (1) update SESSION_HANDOFF.md with this session's results, (2) add or update the matching memory entry in MEMORY.md, (3) show the diff of both files.

install-qml.template: Stage QML fix by: (1) reading the live file at /usr/share/ncde/$ARGUMENTS, (2) reading the staged fix at ~/ncde-staging/scratch/$ARGUMENTS, (3) showing the diff, (4) handing the operator the sudo install command.
install-qml.description: Stage and prepare QML fix for operator install
